hook: A submerged anomaly near Nikumaroro could finally solve the 1937 mystery of Amelia Earhart.

sections.voiceover: A submerged anomaly near Nikumaroro could finally solve the 1937 mystery of Amelia Earhart.
Seventeen researchers arrived at the remote Pacific atoll on Monday. Their vessel, the Marin Mainiku, completed an 830-nautical-mile voyage. What lies beneath the lagoon at Nikumaroro?
b_roll: Research vessel Marin Mainiku at sea

sections.voiceover: Except Purdue University and the Archaeological Legacy Institute joined this exact search.
Seventeen boat crew members joined the team to inspect the Taraia Object. Divers are now examining the submerged aircraft target.
The 1937 disappearance faces its final test.
